messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How have things been going this week — any changes with your blood pressure or how you've been feeling overall?

Honestly not good. Checked my BP this morning, it was 178/112. I've had a pounding headache since last night and some kind of pressure at the back of my head. Took my pill but it doesn't seem to be doing anything.

Thank you for telling me — I want you to know I'm taking this seriously. I've logged that reading. A blood pressure of 178/112 alongside a headache is something our nursing team needs to follow up on directly, so I've sent them a flag right now. They're showing a median response time of 31 hours. If at any point things feel worse — especially chest pain, vision changes, sudden confusion, or anything that feels really off — please call 911 and don't wait for us. Is there anything else I should pass along to the nurse?
Yeah I did take my lisinopril this morning, 10mg like always. Was wondering if I should take another one or double up since it's so high.

Got it — I've logged your lisinopril dose this morning. I can't give you advice on whether to adjust it, though; that's exactly the kind of question your nurse is best placed to answer, and it'll be on their radar when they reach out. Anything else you'd like me to add to the note for them?
One more thing — my pharmacy says my refill is on hold because of something with my insurance. I'm almost out.

I'm sorry you're dealing with that on top of everything else. Insurance and pharmacy issues are outside what I can help with right now — you'd need to call your insurer or the pharmacy directly to get that sorted. I'd mention the refill situation to the nurse when they call you too, since running low on medication is something they'd want to know. Take care of yourself, and don't hesitate to call 911 if anything gets worse before you hear from us.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
